text: Rais Samia Suluhu Hassan alizindua mradi mpya jijini Dodoma mwezi Machi.
gloss: President Samia Suluhu Hassan launched a new project in Dodoma city in March.

text: Wizkid go perform for Lagos on Friday, and Davido go join am.
gloss: Wizkid will perform in Lagos on Friday, and Davido will join him.

text: Shugaba Bola Tinubu ya ziyarci Kano a ranar Litinin.
gloss: President Bola Tinubu visited Kano on Monday.

text: Timu ya Simba SC ilishinda mechi dhidi ya Yanga tarehe 5 Januari.
gloss: Simba SC won the match against Yanga on 5 January.

text: United Nations don open new office for Nairobi since 2019.
gloss: The United Nations opened a new office in Nairobi in 2019.

text: Chuo Kikuu cha Nairobi kitafungua mihula mipya mwaka ujao.
gloss: The University of Nairobi will open new semesters next year.

text: Aliko Dangote ya kafa kamfanin Dangote Group a birnin Legas.
gloss: Aliko Dangote founded the Dangote Group company in Lagos city.

text: Kampuni ya Safaricom ilianzisha huduma ya M-Pesa mjini Nairobi mwaka 2007.
gloss: The company Safaricom launched the M-Pesa service in Nairobi in 2007.

text: Everybody dey happy as rain fall for the whole afternoon.
gloss: Everyone is happy because it rained the whole afternoon.

text: Waziri Mkuu atahutubia Bunge la Uganda mjini Kampala kesho asubuhi.
gloss: The Prime Minister will address the Parliament of Uganda in Kampala tomorrow morning.
